about: NavisLabs launch film — V6 copy: the single source of truth for every spoken and on-screen word. The voiceover is the founder's final performance in eight chunks (P1–P8); the words below are exactly the approved script and must not be rewritten. Timing comes from the measured audio (navislabs_v6_voice_analysis.json); entities come from src/data/navislabs_v6_launch_state.json.

products.name: Navis App
products.for: people inside an organization: what changed, why it matters, waiting on you; prepares actions for a person to review and approve

products.name: Navis Developer
products.for: developers, AI agents, teams and solo builders: company context over MCP / API / SDK / CLI, cited facts with source and freshness, permission checks, recorded runs

never: a learning / outcome loop that is already built

voice_direction: Abhishek Meena's own voice (or an ElevenLabs clone of it made with the founder's permission). Calm, deep, precise, technical, confident, understated, founder-led — natural to Abhishek's own accent. Not a commercial announcer, trailer voice, AI voice, overly American, overly dramatic, or fast social-media narration.

chunks.text: Your people and agents see different truths. [pause] The truth is scattered across the systems where work happens. People rebuild it by hand. Agents start without it.

chunks.text: Navis turns those signals into one shared understanding. [pause] Every email, meeting, document and message becomes a signal — remembered, connected, and turned into what should happen next.

chunks.text: Inside a company, the Navis App is for people. It shows what changed — and why it matters. Every fact has its source, its time, and how fresh it is. When something needs a decision, Navis prepares the next step. [pause] A person decides. [pause] Then the company acts.

chunks.text: The same company's agents use Navis Developer. Invite the team. Connect once — through MCP, API, SDK or CLI. The agent asks — and gets the company's context, with sources and freshness. Navis isn't the model. [pause] It supplies the company's truth. Every request is checked against its permissions. The agent does the work, and the run is on record.
